title: 列出「没有填写备注」的客户
goal: 能用 IS NULL 取空值，并知道 = NULL 与空字符串都不是它
trap: `WHERE` 写错了会报错，能马上发现
reference: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE note IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE NOT (c.note IS NOT NULL)
antiPatterns: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE note = NULL
SELECT name FROM customers WHERE note = ''
explain: NULL 参与任何比较的结果都是「未知」，WHERE 只保留为真的行，所以 = NULL 永远返回空。空字符串也不是 NULL：它是一格有值但长度为零的数据。数据集里两者刻意各有一条。

title: 统计每个客户的有效订单数
goal: 分清 COUNT(*) 与 COUNT(列)，并知道 LEFT JOIN 下空匹配算不算一单
trap: `COUNT(*)` 和 `COUNT(列)` 结果总是相同
reference: SELECT c.name AS customer, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
alternatives: SELECT c.name AS customer, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS order_count FROM customers c
antiPatterns: SELECT c.name AS customer, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
SELECT c.name AS customer, COUNT(o.customer_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
explain: LEFT JOIN 之后没匹配的客户仍然占一行、右表列全是 NULL。COUNT(*) 会把这行数成 1，而 COUNT(o.id) 跳过 NULL 得到 0。这正是「没下单的客户」与「下了一单」的唯一区别。

title: 算出每笔订单的总额
goal: 金额全程用 DECIMAL 累加，并用 ABS 处理退货负数
trap: `FLOAT`/`DOUBLE` 只是精度低一点，不影响业务
reference: SELECT o.id AS order_id, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id
alternatives: SELECT i.order_id, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS total FROM order_items i GROUP BY i.order_id
antiPatterns: SELECT o.id AS order_id, CAST(SUM(i.qty) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id
SELECT o.id AS order_id, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id
explain: 总额是「单价 × 数量」逐项相乘后求和。SUM(单价) 漏掉数量，SUM(数量) 漏掉单价——两个都错得很合理，不报错，只是金额不对。CAST 到 DECIMAL(12,2) 保证结果仍是定点数，不引入浮点。

title: 列出每个客户最近一笔订单
goal: 用相关子查询取「每组最大值」，知道 GROUP BY 取不到整行
trap: 建了索引查询就一定用它
reference: SELECT c.name AS customer, (SELECT MAX(o2.id) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id) AS order_id FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o3 WHERE o3.customer_id = c.id)
alternatives: SELECT c.name AS customer, MAX(o.id) AS order_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
antiPatterns: SELECT c.name AS customer, MAX(o.created) AS order_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
SELECT c.name AS customer, COUNT(o.id) AS order_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
explain: 「每组的最大值」是一个聚合问题，但「那一行的其他列」不是。MAX(created) 取出的是时间，不是订单号；要拿到整行必须用相关子查询或窗口函数。用 COUNT 更是另一个量。

title: 统计每个城市的客户数
goal: 能按关联列分组，并意识到城市名本身不该重复存在订单表里
trap: 一个字段存逗号分隔的列表很方便
reference: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city
alternatives: SELECT c.city, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers x WHERE x.city = c.city) AS customer_count FROM customers c GROUP BY c.city
antiPatterns: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM orders GROUP BY city
SELECT city, COUNT(id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
explain: 客户数与「订单数」是两个不同的数：从 orders 分组会得到每城市有多少笔订单。第二种写法还多了个凭空的门槛——它会把所有城市都筛掉，结果为空。

title: 让扣库存真正扣得动
goal: 能识别「条件更新不检查影响行数」与「事务边界写错」两种坑
trap: 数据库保证了业务的一致性
broken: BEGIN; UPDATE customers SET id = id - 1 WHERE id = 1 AND id > 0; COMMIT; SELECT id AS remaining FROM customers WHERE id = 1;
reference: SELECT MIN(c.id) AS remaining FROM customers c WHERE c.id IN (1, 2, 3)
explain: 本题演示的是「条件更新必须检查影响行数」：`UPDATE … WHERE id > 0` 在条件不满足时返回 0 行，但语句本身不报错。应用若把这当成成功，就会记一笔没有库存支撑的订单。数据库只保证约束不被违反，保证不了你的业务规则。

title: 回滚之后应当读到旧值
goal: 知道 ROLLBACK 会撤销本事务的改动，而普通 SELECT 读到的是自己会话的状态
trap: `SELECT` 加了事务就能防止并发修改
broken: BEGIN; UPDATE order_items SET unit_price = 1.00 WHERE order_id = 10; SELECT customer_id, SUM(unit_price) AS amount FROM order_items WHERE order_id = 10 GROUP BY customer_id; ROLLBACK;
reference: SELECT o.customer_id, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id
alternatives: SELECT o.customer_id, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id
antiPatterns: SELECT o.customer_id, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id
explain: 这段代码把「改价」与「读结果」放在同一个事务里，读到的是自己的未提交改动；ROLLBACK 之后它该回到原值。若你在 ROLLBACK 之后仍读到 1.00，说明事务边界没生效（比如中间有 DDL 触发了隐式提交）。

title: 只用范围条件查出本周订单
goal: 能用范围条件代替函数包列，让索引有机会生效
reference: SELECT id AS order_id FROM orders WHERE created >= '2026-10-20 00:00:00' AND created < '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
alternatives: SELECT o.id AS order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.created BETWEEN '2026-10-20 00:00:00' AND '2026-10-21 23:59:59'
antiPatterns: SELECT id AS order_id FROM orders WHERE DATE(created) = '2026-10-21'
SELECT id AS order_id FROM orders WHERE YEAR(created) = 2026
explain: 函数包住列之后索引就用不上了（索引里存的是原始值）。日期区间一律写成「左闭右开」的范围条件：>= 起点、< 次日零点，既走索引又不漏当天最后一秒。

title: 按客户汇总营收并按金额降序
goal: 把连接、聚合、排序组合起来，并知道明细行会让订单数被放大
trap: 订单总价可以直接取 `products.price` 算
reference: SELECT c.name AS customer, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
alternatives: SELECT c.name AS customer, CAST(agg.revenue AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS revenue, agg.order_count FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id AS cid, SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id) agg ON agg.cid = c.id
antiPatterns: SELECT c.name AS customer, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price * i.qty) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS revenue, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name

SELECT c.name AS customer, CAST(SUM(i.unit_price) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name
explain: 营收必须用「下单时的 unit_price × qty」（快照价），不能取商品表现价。订单数要用 COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)：连接明细后同一个订单会出现多行，直接 COUNT 会把一单数成多单。
